item.title: Whiskers 0.8.60
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.60

### File Transcription

  • Improved File Transcription startup so saved queues and results are ready sooner when you open the app
  • Improved model and API key loading so file transcription settings stay more consistent when the app starts

    • ### Cloud Transcription

  • Improved cloud model key selection by keeping the key picker with the selected provider
  • Improved cloud model discovery so switching between API keys is less likely to show stale model options
  • Improved live cloud dictation so longer stretches of speech are sent in steadier chunks

    • ### Settings & Setup

  • Fixed installed version details in General Settings so they refresh after an app update without reopening Settings
  • Improved permission and shortcut setup messages so recovery steps are clearer when macOS access needs attention

    • ### Support & History

  • Improved transcript history loading with clearer progress and retry behavior when loading more transcripts
  • Improved support diagnostics by tightening attachment limits and redacting more device identifiers
